build_get_base_name_to_sets_of_related_o: build a mapping of related ops by calling get_base_name_to_sets_of_related_ops to group convolution, pooling, and activation functions
create_get_base_name_for_op: create a lookup of the base name for a given op using get_base_name_for_op and a prebuilt name-to-sets mapping
add_op_to_sets_of_related_ops: add an op to an existing set of related ops using add_op_to_sets_of_related_ops with a related op anchor
test_get_node_type_to_io_type_map: test the node type to I/O type mapping by calling get_node_type_to_io_type_map to classify fp32 and int8 modules and functions
review_get_unmatchable_types_map: review the unmatchable types map by calling get_unmatchable_types_map to identify ops that cannot be pattern-matched
